mappings.reasoning: product_ref contains values like VLD-BAG-LUNE-NR, which are SKU-style product codes that encode category, model, and colour.
English titles such as 'Lune bag' are the most likely source for the product name; title_fr is the French variant and has no direct target column.
brand_name holds the brand value 'Maison Vellandre' and maps directly to brand.
Material composition descriptions such as '100% soie' map to the material field.
Colour codes (NR, IV, BL, MR, CA) map to the color field, though the values are codes rather than full colour names.
Size labels such as 38, 40, 90x90 and TU map directly to the size field.
French title has no target column in the Product schema, so it is dropped.
Season collection (FW26, SS26) has no matching target column in the Product schema, so it is dropped.
